notices.allHaveCovers: Every game in scope already has a cover
notices.allHaveArt: Every game in scope already has these pictures
notices.artReplaced: The current file moves to {{folder}} before the new one is written
notices.artUnreadable: The picture file cannot be read
notices.otherGamesLeftOut: Skipped pictures of games not on this device: {{count}}
notices.nothingForTheseGames: Nothing in the set belongs to a game on this device
notices.artOtherMarket: Only another region’s release in {{sources}}: the slot stays empty rather than show the wrong box, disc or spine
notices.artPresent: Kept pictures the device already has: {{count}}
notices.alreadyCommitted: This change was already visible to OPL, so it is completed instead of undone
notices.alreadyThatFormat: The game is already in this format
notices.appBootMissing: Boot file {{boot}} is not in the app folder
notices.appleDouble: macOS ._ files in CD, DVD, LNG or APPS ({{files}}) slow OPL down or show up as bogus entries
notices.archiveKept: Art and cheats inside art.tar or cht.tar are not touched
notices.artNotLoaded: {{file}}: this loader only reads PNG art
notices.artTooLarge: {{file}} is {{width}}×{{height}}; OPL rejects art over 1024 pixels
notices.audioTracksDropped_one: {{count}} audio track is left out: OPL reads only the data track, so music played from CD audio is missing
notices.audioTracksDropped_other: {{count}} audio tracks are left out: OPL reads only the data track, so music played from CD audio is missing
notices.binLayoutDetected: No CUE sheet: the BIN was read as a single {{mode}} track
notices.cdTooLarge: {{size, bytes}} is more than a PS2 CD holds; it is probably a DVD and belongs in DVD/
notices.cfgLibconfig: CFG in wOPL’s libconfig format; YAOPLM leaves it alone
notices.chunksDeletedAfterImage: The ul chunks are deleted once the image and ul.cfg are complete
notices.clusterSmall: {{kib}} KiB FAT32 clusters make OPL read more of the FAT when a game starts; 32 KiB is recommended
notices.clusterTooLarge: {{kib}} KiB clusters are reported to cause problems; up to 32 KiB on FAT32 and 32–128 KiB on exFAT are safe
notices.compatibilityBits: $Compatibility={{value}} sets bits outside {{allowed}} for this loader
notices.compressedToZso: Stored as ZSO: smaller on the device; OPL 1.2.0 beta and newer read it
notices.containerMismatch: The extension says {{extension}} but the file is {{content}}
notices.coversPresent_one: {{count}} game already has a cover and was left alone
notices.coversPresent_other: {{count}} games already have a cover and were left alone
notices.duplicateStartup: Another game also has ID {{startup}}; they share CFG, art and cheats
notices.exfatNeedsOpl12: OPL 1.1.0 cannot read exFAT; use FAT32 or OPL 1.2.0 beta
notices.exfatRecommended: exFAT is recommended for OPL 1.2.0 beta: games over 4 GiB stay one image
notices.fatNeededToBoot: FreeMcBoot and old uLaunchELF cannot start OPL from exFAT; this device must be FAT32 on MBR
notices.fromArchive: Read straight from the archive; nothing is unpacked to the computer first
notices.fsUnreadable: OPL cannot read {{fs}} from USB or SD; use exFAT (OPL 1.2.0 beta) or FAT32
notices.gptUnsupported: GPT partition table: OPL 1.1.0 and old loaders read MBR only
notices.idKept: Game IDs do not change: settings, art, cheats and memory cards keep working
notices.idKeptInName: The image does not name {{startup}}, but ul.cfg does: the ID stays in the file name, where OPL reads it first
notices.idNotInName: The game ID {{startup}} cannot start a file name; OPL will read it from the image
notices.imageDeletedAfterUl: The image is deleted once the ul chunks and ul.cfg are complete
notices.journalUnreadable: Journal {{file}} cannot be read ({{error}}); check the device by hand
notices.largeGamesAsUl: FAT32 holds files up to 4 GiB: larger games are split into 1 GiB ul chunks
notices.mediaConflict: The image is marked as a CD but holds {{sectors}} sectors, more than a CD; check CD or DVD
notices.misaligned: The partition starts at byte {{offset}}, not on a 1 MiB boundary (slower writes)
notices.nameIdMismatch: The file name says {{name}} but SYSTEM.CNF says {{image}}; OPL uses {{name}}
notices.nestedArchive: An archive inside an archive is not opened; unpack the outer one
notices.noArtSource: No source to ask: every cover source is off
notices.noSourceForKind: None of the sources that are on has this type ({{kind}}): turn one on, import a picture set or set it by hand
notices.notInTitleDatabase: The bundled database has no Redump name for this game, and the sources with this type need one
notices.nonAsciiName: Non-ASCII characters in the name: the console may garble it or fail to open the file
notices.noPartitionTable: No partition table: some OPL 1.2.0 builds cannot mount this; MBR with one partition is safest
notices.noSpace: Not enough free space: {{needed, bytes}} needed, {{free, bytes}} available
notices.notExternal: Not a USB or SD device: OPL reads games from USB, MX4SIO, i.LINK, an internal HDD or SMB
notices.nothingToFetch: No game to fetch a cover for
notices.oldImageDeleted: {{name}} is deleted once the {{format}} is complete
notices.partialSector: The image is {{size}} bytes, not a whole number of 2048-byte sectors
notices.ps1Game: A PS1 disc: OPL does not run it (POPStarter support is planned)
notices.relatedCopied: The game ID changes from {{old}} to {{new}}: its CFG, art and cheat files ({{files}}) are copied, because another game still uses the old ID (VMC cards keep their names)
notices.relatedKept: CFG, art and cheat files of {{startup}} stay on the device ({{files}})
notices.relatedMoved: The game ID changes from {{old}} to {{new}}: its CFG, art and cheat files ({{files}}) move with it (VMC cards keep their names)
notices.relatedShared: CFG, art and cheats stay: another game also uses {{startup}}
notices.remoteShare: Network share: OPL speaks SMBv1 only, opens names up to 159 bytes and at most 10 ul parts
notices.restartOpl: Restart OPL to see the new name: it notices ul.cfg changes by size only
notices.sectorSize: Logical sectors are {{size}} bytes; OPL reads 512-byte sectors only (often a USB adapter issue)
notices.smbNameTooLong: The file name is {{length}} bytes; over SMB OPL opens at most 159
notices.sourceArchiveKept: The game comes from an archive: the archive is not deleted
notices.sourcesDeleted: The source files are deleted after each game is copied
notices.staleCache: games.bin still lists this file as {{cached}}, but the image is {{image}}; OPL shows {{cached}} until games.bin is deleted
notices.storedAsUl: FAT32 holds files up to 4 GiB: the game is stored as 1 GiB ul chunks ({{parts}})
notices.systemVolume: This volume holds the operating system
notices.titleShortened: The title was shortened to fit OPL’s limits: {{title}}
notices.titleTooLong: The title is longer than 160 characters
notices.tooLargeForFat32: The ISO would be over 4 GiB, more than FAT32 holds
notices.tooLargeUseUl: The ISO would be over 4 GiB, more than FAT32 holds; convert to ul instead
notices.ulCfgTrailingBytes: ul.cfg ends with stray bytes ({{extra}}); OPL shows them as a broken game
notices.ulDuplicateRecords: ul.cfg lists this game {{times}} times: every record goes with the chunks
notices.ulPartSize: Chunk {{part}} ({{name}}) is {{size}} bytes; every chunk but the last must be exactly 1 GiB
notices.ulTitle: ul.cfg holds at most 32 ASCII characters; the title becomes “{{name}}”
notices.ulTooManyPartsForSmb: The game needs {{parts}} ul chunks; OPL opens at most 10 over SMB
notices.unfinishedOperation: An earlier operation on this device did not finish (journal {{id}}); undo or finish it first
notices.uppercaseExtension: Uppercase extension: OPL shows no ISO/ZSO label
notices.vmcMissing: VMC slot {{slot}}: VMC/{{name}}.bin does not exist
notices.zsoDecompressedForOpl110: OPL 1.1.0 cannot read ZSO: the image is stored decompressed
notices.zsoDecompressedForUl: ul chunks hold plain ISO data: the ZSO is decompressed
notices.zsoMayNotFit: FAT32 holds files up to 4 GiB: if the ZSO comes out larger, the conversion is undone
notices.zsoNotForProfile: OPL 1.1.0 cannot read ZSO: the game is stored as ISO
notices.vmcReplaced: {{path}} is replaced by a blank card; the old one moves to {{folder}} with its saves
notices.vmcNotOnDevice: VMC slot {{slot}}: VMC/{{name}}.bin is not on the device; OPL creates an 8 MiB card when its VMC menu is opened, or asks at launch to use the memory card instead
notices.settingsUnchanged: The settings are already like this; nothing to write
notices.vmcFragmented: {{path}} lies on the device in several pieces ({{fragments}}): OPL offers the memory card instead. Free some space or defragment the device, then create the card again

artSources.xlenore: Front covers by game ID, the set PCSX2 uses. No licence stated: fetched on request only.
artSources.oplm: Every type by game ID from the last OPL Manager art backup (2024-09) on archive.org: the only open source of icons, back covers, spines and backgrounds. Its index (8.6 MB) is read once, then each picture is one request.
artSources.libretro: Covers, screenshots, title screens and logos by Redump name, as RetroArch shows them. A cover comes from here when xlenore and the OPL Manager backup have none.
artSources.screenscraper: Every type by serial, with the region of each picture. Needs a build with ScreenScraper’s developer key; an account raises the daily quota.

settings.mirrorHint: A mirror is a local copy of a source (a clone of its repository, or an unpacked OPL Manager backup): pictures are read from it instead of the network.
settings.screenscraperAccountHint: Optional. Kept in this app’s settings on this computer and sent only to ScreenScraper.
settings.clearArtCacheFailed: The cache could not be cleared completely: {{error}}
settings.simpleModeHint: Hides sorting, counters, conversions, picture sets, the jobs page and technical details. Turn it off to see everything.
settings.aboutDescription: Versions, licences and the sources this app is built on.
settings.titlesDbState: Game IDs: {{count}}, built {{built}} (Redump names from libretro-database {{dat}})
settings.coverSourcesHint: Downloaded only when you ask, cached locally and written to your device. Never redistributed.
settings.noLicense: no licence stated; used on request only

settings.dumpsDescription: Images are compared with the Redump PS2 DAT by their SHA-1. The DAT is kept on this computer.

reason.cdImage: CD image: Redump lists CDs as BIN

reasonLong.noDat: There is no Redump DAT on this computer yet: download or import it, then check again.
reasonLong.notListed: Redump lists neither a dump with these hashes nor this game ID: most likely a homebrew, a hack, a translation or a disc Redump does not have yet.
reasonLong.cdImage: Redump hashes CDs as raw BIN tracks, so an ISO of a CD never matches. The entries below have this game ID; the same number of sectors means the ISO likely comes from that disc.

dump.badDumpHint: Redump lists this game ID but no dump with these hashes: the image is damaged, modified (a patch or a translation) or from a version Redump does not list.
dump.serialMismatch: the game ID differs from Redump’s
dump.candidates: Redump entries with this game ID:
dump.fromCache: Hashes from the cache: the image has not changed since it was read.
dump.byTrack: Checked by the data track of the BIN or CHD the game was added from.
dump.trackHashes: Data track of the added dump
dump.comparedWith: Compared with the Redump DAT {{version}}, entries: {{games}}.
dump.verifyDescription: Each image is read in full and its SHA-1 is looked up in the Redump PS2 DAT. Nothing is written to the device.
dump.scopeUncheckedHint: Games read before are skipped unless their image changed.
dump.scopeAllHint: Unchanged images are not read again: their hashes are cached.
dump.freshHint: Ignores cached hashes. Finds damage that left the file size and date alone, for example on a failing stick.
dump.md5Hint: SHA-1 and CRC-32 are always computed; MD5 is only for comparing with other tools.
dump.cancelled: Cancelled: the games checked so far keep their result.
dump.noDat: No Redump DAT on this computer yet.
dump.nextCheck: Redump can be asked again after {{date}}
dump.noSerials: This DAT has no game IDs, so bad dumps show as unknown. Redump’s “serial, version” DAT has them.
dump.datHint: Redump is asked only when you press the button, and at most once a week. A DAT downloaded by hand (.dat or Redump’s .zip) can be imported instead.

update.tooSoon: Redump was asked less than a week ago; it can be asked again after {{date}}.

dump.browseDescription: A .dat file or Redump’s .zip, inside the folders the server was started with.

convert.description: The new image is written first; the old one is deleted only once the new one is complete. Game IDs, settings, art and cheats stay as they are.

hints.iso: A plain image: every OPL version reads it; takes the most space.
hints.zso: Compressed with LZ4: smaller; OPL 1.2.0 beta and newer read it. A few games load more slowly.
hints.ul: 1 GiB parts listed in ul.cfg: for old loaders, or for FAT32 with games over 4 GiB. Titles are cut to 32 characters.

convert.deleteNote: The plan lists every file; deleting the old images needs your confirmation.

reasons.appBadBoot: boot must be a plain ELF file name, not {{boot}}
reasons.binEndsEarly: the BIN ends before its data track does
reasons.binMissing: the BIN named in the sheet ({{file}}) is missing
reasons.binNoVolume: a BIN without a CUE sheet, and no ISO 9660 volume in it
reasons.binPartialSector: the track is {{length}} bytes from sector {{start}}, not a whole number of {{size}}-byte sectors
reasons.chdBadMetadata: the CD track metadata cannot be read: {{error}}
reasons.chdInArchive: a CHD inside an archive is not read: unpack the CHD first (it is compressed already)
reasons.chdLayout: a CHD of {{unit}}-byte units is neither a CD nor a DVD
reasons.chdNeedsParent: this CHD needs a parent CHD; merge it first (chdman copy)
reasons.chtBlankName: line {{line}} renames the next cheat to blanks
reasons.chtCodesWithoutName: codes before the first name are dropped ({{codes}})
reasons.chtTooManyCheats: more than 250 cheats: OPL writes past its array
reasons.cnfEof: SYSTEM.CNF ends inside the BOOT2 line
reasons.cnfNoColon: the BOOT2 value has no device prefix such as cdrom0:
reasons.cnfNoFile: the BOOT2 value names no file
reasons.cnfNulByte: SYSTEM.CNF has a NUL byte before its BOOT2 line
reasons.cnfTooLong: the BOOT2 value is too long for OPL’s 64-byte buffer
reasons.cueFileType: FILE type {{type}} is not supported; only BINARY
reasons.cueNoFile: the CUE sheet names no FILE
reasons.cueNoTrack: the CUE sheet names no TRACK
reasons.cueTrackNoEnd: track {{track}} has no INDEX, so the data track has no end
reasons.cueTrackOrder: track {{track}} starts before the data track does
reasons.isoUnreadable: the ISO 9660 file system cannot be read: {{error}}
reasons.noBoot2: SYSTEM.CNF has no BOOT2 line (a PS1 disc, a video DVD or a damaged image)
reasons.noChdSupport: this build of YAOPLM reads no CHD images
reasons.noSystemCnf: there is no SYSTEM.CNF;1 in the root directory (OPL needs exactly this name)
reasons.recordNonAsciiName: the title has non-ASCII bytes; OPL hashes them unpredictably
reasons.recordUnknownMedia: media byte {{value}} is neither CD nor DVD; OPL shows it as DVD
reasons.secondDataTrack: track {{track}} is a second data track (a mixed-mode or CD-Extra disc)
reasons.trackNotData: track mode {{mode}} holds no PS2 data
reasons.vmcBadMagic: not a PS2 memory card image (no superblock magic)
reasons.vmcCardType: card type {{type}} is not a PS2 card (2)
reasons.vmcNotWholeMib: the size {{size}} is not a whole number of MiB
reasons.vmcSizeMismatch: the file is {{file}} bytes but the superblock describes {{card}}
reasons.zsoBlockSize: the block size is {{size}}; OPL only reads 2048-byte blocks
reasons.zsoPartialBlock: the uncompressed size {{size}} is not a multiple of 2048; the tail is unreadable
reasons.compatibilityBits: modes {{value}} include bits this loader does not know (allowed {{allowed}})
reasons.altStartupTooLong: the alternative startup {{value}} is too long (at most {{max}} characters)
reasons.altStartupChars: the alternative startup {{value}} is not a file name on the disc (only letters, digits, underscores, dots, hyphens and backslashes)
reasons.gsmVmode: GSM video mode {{value}} is not one of OPL’s 0 to {{max}}
reasons.gsmOffset: GSM shift {{value}} is outside what OPL’s menu allows (−{{max}} to {{max}})
reasons.cfgKeyTooLong: key {{key}} is too long (at most {{max}} characters)
reasons.cfgKeyChars: key {{key}} has a character OPL cannot store (=, a line break or a leading space)
reasons.cfgRuntimeKey: key {{key}} starts with #: OPL never saves such keys
reasons.cfgValueTooLong: the value of {{key}} is too long ({{length}} bytes; OPL keeps {{max}})
reasons.cfgValueChars: the value of {{key}} has a line break or NUL
reasons.vmcNameChars: {{name}} has characters outside ASCII or ones a file name cannot hold

cfg.heading: Game settings
cfg.libconfig: {{path}} is in wOPL’s libconfig format: YAOPLM shows it but does not change it.
cfg.modesHint: Turn a mode on only when the game does not start, freezes or shows glitches; the OPL compatibility list says which one helps.

modeHints.1: Reads at the speed and in the way of the console’s drive
modeHints.2: Another way of reading data, synchronously
modeHints.4: Takes OPL’s hooks off the system calls
modeHints.8: Skips the game’s PSS and Bink videos
modeHints.16: For DVD-9 images whose two layers were joined into one
modeHints.32: Turns off the button combination that returns to OPL during play
modeHints.64: Neutrino only: fixes a game buffer overrun
modeHints.128: Reads a DVD as slowly as a CD

cfg.otherBits: The CFG also sets bits {{bits}}, which this loader does not use; they stay as they are.
cfg.noCard: None: the memory card in the slot
cfg.cardExists: {{name}} is already on the device: choose it in the list.
cfg.newCardDescription: A blank card formatted the way OPL formats it. It is written when the plan is confirmed.
cfg.cardNameHint: VMC/<name>.bin, up to 31 Latin characters. OPL suggests <ID>_0 and <ID>_1; generic_0 and generic_1 are shared by several games.
cfg.cardNameInvalid: Latin letters, digits and signs only, without */:<>?\| and quotes.
cfg.replaceCard: Replace {{name}} with a blank card. The old one, with its saves, moves to the .yaoplm/backup folder on the device.
cfg.offsetRange: OPL’s menu shifts the picture by −{{max}} to {{max}}.
cfg.gsmFieldFixHint: For games that glitch in progressive video modes
cfg.padEmuHint: A DualShock 3 or 4 over USB or Bluetooth in place of a PS2 pad
cfg.altStartupHint: An ELF on the disc to boot instead of the one in SYSTEM.CNF, such as SLUS_200.63; up to {{max}} characters, without ;1. Empty: as usual.
cfg.notThereYet: {{path}} (not there yet: OPL uses its defaults)
cfg.cardReplacing: {{name}} (a new {{size}} MiB card in its place)
